title: The 5 Best Free Keyword Research Tools in 2026 | Zapier

facts.fact: Zapier's author says they considered more than 90 tools with a free option for keyword research before testing.
facts.quote: I considered more than 90 tools with a free option for keyword research.

facts.fact: Zapier's author spent over a dozen hours testing the keyword research apps in the roundup.
facts.quote: After spending over a dozen hours with these apps this year

facts.fact: The article is dated June 2, 2021, though its title refers to 2026.
Semrush's free plan, as listed by Zapier, allows 10 Analytics reports per day and 10 tracked keywords.
facts.quote: 10 Analytics reports per day, 10 tracked keywords

facts.fact: KWFinder's free plan, as listed by Zapier, allows 5 searches per day.
AnswerThePublic's free plan, as listed by Zapier, allows 3 searches per day.
Allintitle KW Explorer's free plan, as listed by Zapier, provides 10 tokens per month.
Zapier states Google Keyword Planner is completely free forever, even if the user does not use Google Ads.
facts.quote: Completely free forever, even if you don't use Google Ads

facts.fact: Zapier's selection criteria require that all included keyword tools provide, at minimum, traffic, keyword difficulty, and competitive SERP analysis.
facts.quote: All of the apps I selected include, at minimum, traffic, keyword difficulty, and competitive SERP analysis.

facts.fact: Google Keyword Planner is completely free to use, even without buying Google Ads, according to Zapier.
facts.quote: It's completely free (even if you don't buy Google Ads), so you never have to worry about running into limits or expensive upgrades.

facts.fact: KWFinder's free plan includes up to 5 keyword searches per day.
facts.quote: Free plan includes up to 5 keyword searches per day

facts.fact: AnswerThePublic's free plan includes 3 searches per day.
facts.quote: Free plan includes 3 searches per day

facts.fact: Allintitle KW Explorer's free plan includes up to 10 tokens per month, roughly equal to about 10 bulk keyword searches or 5 uses of the Keyword Explorer tool.
facts.quote: The free plan includes up to 10 "tokens" per month, which breaks out to about 10 bulk keyword searches or 5 uses of the more targeted Keyword Explorer tool.

facts.fact: KWFinder's keyword opportunities feature flags top results as outdated if they are more than six months old.
facts.quote: it can identify if the top results are outdated (more than six months old) or missing the full keyword in their meta title.

facts.fact: Allintitle KW Explorer's free plan includes up to 10 tokens per month, where one general keyword search uses 1 token and one Keyword Explorer search uses 2 tokens.
facts.quote: Free for up to 10 tokens per month (one general keyword search uses 1 token; one Keyword Explorer search uses 2 tokens).

facts.fact: Allintitle's Starter plan costs $49 per month and includes 50,000 tokens per month plus access to every feature.
facts.quote: or $49/month for the Starter plan, which includes 50,000 tokens per month and access to every feature.

facts.fact: Allintitle's Related Keywords table can be filtered to show top keywords from non-Google sources including Amazon, eBay, YouTube, TikTok, and Perplexity.
facts.quote: This makes it easy to find the top keywords across a number of non-Google sources, including Amazon, eBay, YouTube, TikTok, and Perplexity.

facts.fact: The article was originally published in June 2021 and most recently updated in July 2026.
facts.quote: This article was originally published in June 2021. The most recent update was in July 2026.
